headline: Nittobo, a Japanese maker of glass cloth used in AI chip packaging, is expanding production of its T-Glass because demand from AI chip makers is straining supply.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: only the headline and one opening line could be read, so the size and timing of the expansion are unverified.
importance_line: Tight supply of a material used in AI chip packaging is a pinch point for chip makers and the AI hardware built on their chips, but how much output is being added, and when, is not yet known.
summary: DigiTimes, the Taiwanese trade outlet, reports that Nittobo, a Japanese maker of T-Glass, a specialised glass cloth used in AI chip packaging, is expanding production as demand from AI chip makers strains global supply.
notes: Headline only: DigiTimes paywalled (one-sentence teaser visible), no other outlet found carrying today's expansion. Description of T-Glass and Nittobo's Japanese base comes from TrendForce, 6 Aug 2026, not from today's article.
